A repeat visit to the same cave finds it still emptied.","expect":"accept: the expedition and resupply loop continues through a mid-work reload without losing work or persistent consequences, and the repeat expedition does not regenerate the reward","expect_source":"leaf:stillsand_walk","by":"examiner"}],"coverage_note":"The 18 scenarios comprise 7 accepts and 11 rejects across 13 leaves: expedition_ocean, prepared_harbour, ordinary_work, practical_fortune (x2), direct_sun, sand_signs (x2), giant_encounters, hydration_exclusion, gale_passage, current_water (x2), debt_return (x2), giant_history (x2) and stillsand_walk. Routine play is covered by e01, e03, e04 and e12. Uncertainty is covered by e04, e07 and e08. Saved state is covered by e11, e12, e13 and e18. Scope boundaries and does-not clauses are covered by e02 (unresolved rock rest), e04 (no guaranteed fortune), e13 (agricultural film is later), e14 (RM ledger-inert) and e17 (no general spoilage immunity). The scene_observer instrument and the floor items are intentionally not used as verdict sources, so each verdict stays tied to a stated experience leaf."}
